CLAIM: G004's 20 ms gate is BELOW DSV4F's DRAM floor on the current artifact. This is a physical-limit claim and it names the saturated resource, as S004 s4 requires.
named_saturated_resource: memory bandwidth: 10.280 GB moved per token against a MEASURED honest decode ceiling of 411.51 GB/s

measured_today.diagnosis: occupancy / launch-geometry bound on MLA+gate plus an FP4 access-pattern issue

NOT_the_q80_story: Q80's wall was serial reconstruction and fell 23.7x when codes were consumed in-register. DSV4F's ALU is IDLE at 0.77%, so there is no equivalent reconstruction tax to remove. Porting the Q80 fix here would waste the lane, and the diagnosis lane says so explicitly.
EXACT_MISSING_INPUT: A DSV4F artifact whose per-token ACTIVE bytes are <= 8.230 GB - and realistically far lower, since 8.230 GB assumes running AT the ceiling and nothing does. At today's 6.3% of roof it would need roughly 0.5 GB. Reducing bytes means fewer active weights per token or a lower-BPW representation; occupancy work alone cannot reach the gate.
what_occupancy_work_CAN_buy: DSV4F is at 6.3% of its own 40 TPS roof. Closing that gap is worth up to ~16x and takes it from 2.5 to ~40 TPS. That is real and worth doing - it simply cannot cross 50 TPS on this artifact.
